blind.description: An open stone sarcophagus or rectangular tomb basin with its detached lid leaning against the back side. The exterior walls of the main box feature classical decorative relief panels with circular medallions flanked by pilasters, resting on a stepped stone plinth and topped with a thick lip. The lid leans diagonally against one long side, decorated with a carved sunburst medallion motif. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized with hand-painted textures resembling weathered sandstone or limestone. The model stands firmly on its own base, sits flat on the floor, and has no hovering, broken, or unpainted elements.
blind.from_above: A rectangular hollow chamber surrounded by thick stone rims, with the top edge of the angled stone lid visible along the upper edge displaying a semicircular carved sunburst emblem.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly waist-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure), with a length of about 5.5 to 6 feet (roughly equal to the figure's height) and a depth of about 3.5 feet including the leaning lid.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
